label: Microsoft Entra identity connector
summary: Prepare tenant-bound federation and optional identity synchronization for an admitted Microsoft Entra directory.
core_boundary: External directory roles and commercial entitlement cannot bypass local authority or make local authentication dependent on a provider. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Bind issuers, directory tenants, application identities and synchronization scope to an admitted organization.
Qualify OIDC claim validation and SCIM identity matching independently; refuse ambiguous usernames and cross-tenant links.
Exercise deprovisioning, group changes, revoked credentials and provider outages while retaining audited local recovery.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
